name: Pacific View Mall
description: Pacific View Mall is an enclosed regional shopping center located in Ventura, California, serving as the primary retail destination for Ventura County. The mall features a diverse mix of national retailers, department stores, dining options, and entertainment venues. Strategically positioned on East Main Street, it provides convenient access for shoppers throughout the region.
summary: Pacific View Mall is Ventura County's premier enclosed shopping destination featuring major department stores and a wide variety of national retailers.
